title: Factorized task x layer FiLM Mirror code
hypothesis: A task factor x layer factor Mirror coordinate recovers held-out FiLM affine states with lower bytes than independent pairs and improves the quality/byte frontier over ordinary factorization.
physical_object: shared 32-channel representation with task/layer conditional FiLM
mirror_coordinate: factorized task x layer affine coefficient code for gamma and beta
logical_multiplicity: 24 task-layer states; six held out from fitting

development.selection_metric: heldout output nMSE, gamma/beta nMSE, actual serialized bytes

fresh.reason: Direct factorized coefficients provide an algebraically matched specificity control.

storage.authority: actual deterministic NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Heldout output nMSE <=1e-3; >=20% fewer bytes than independent table; >=10% byte advantage over direct factorization or generator at matched quality.
failure_gate: Direct factorized coefficients match Mirror within 1% quality/bytes or heldout nMSE >1e-3.
boundaries: no fresh if specificity gate fails
